svg.aria-label: Constructed mixtures, compensated distributions, a single-stain slope and negative-signal noise. A and B use the same asinh scale; dashed thresholds correspond to 200 a.u. Each histogram in D integrates to one and retains negative values. All arrays come from the complete example.
